business_problem: modernize an outdated on-premises entertainment-data stack so Luminate could process multi-terabyte daily feeds faster, share data securely, and launch new analytics products quickly.
solution_summary: Luminate uses Snowflake and Secure Data Sharing on Snowflake to modernize an outdated on-premises entertainment-data stack so Luminate could process multi-terabyte daily feeds faster, share data securely, and launch new analytics products quickly. Streaming, chart, and audience data are centralized in Snowflake so media customers and analysts can work from a faster, more reliable operating view. Secure Data Sharing lets the organization collaborate with partners or downstream consumers on live governed data without creating extra copies. The platform also connects with dbt so upstream systems and downstream consumers stay aligned around the same governed data assets. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, simplifies operations, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across analytics, reporting, and AI. Luminate achieved 334% Faster daily processing for over a trillion data points and 3.5 TB+ Data processed daily.
